overloads.semanticRole: The TRUNCATE TABLE command quickly deletes all the records of aTable .

constraints: Similar in effect to an ALL RECORDS / DELETE SELECTION sequence, but no trigger is called and referential integrity is not checked.

Fails (does nothing, sets OK to 0) if a transaction is underway in the calling process, or if one or more records of aTable are locked by another process; in the locked-record case an error is also generated and no LockedSet system set is created.
Does nothing and sets OK to 1 if aTable is already empty.
Does nothing and sets OK to 0 if aTable is in read-only.
After a successful call, there is no longer any current selection or current record for aTable.
The operation is recorded in the log file, if one exists.
Conceptually similar to the SQL TRUNCATE TABLE command.
